headline: Anakin Coin, a Star Wars-themed Solana memecoin, rises to a top-four spot
backstory: The team describes Anakin Coin ($ANAKIN) as a fan-made Solana memecoin about Anakin Skywalker, launched on pump.fun about 16 hours before this report. Its website frames the character as a 'Chosen One' turned by power, with chapters titled after the film and series arc: The Chosen One, The Turn, Mustafar, The Archives and Join the Dark Side.

The website says the coin has no team bags and no sell tax, and it includes a section of posts that the team says Elon Musk reposted or replied to. The creators also describe the coin as tied to a political framing, with the launch text calling Anakin Skywalker 'a symbol of right-wing extremism.' The site does not name any creators, and it lists its chart and follow links as 'TBA' or 'Soon'.
The creators have published little beyond the website and the launch text. Its X account is listed, but the description and metadata do not describe a specific team, roadmap or partnership.
whyTrending: It is the fourth-largest of today's runners by market cap, and it sits in a group of Anakin and Star Wars-style coins that have drawn large trading attention today.
Buy transactions over the past 24 hours have outnumbered sells, and the coin has had several hourly moves that the desk recorded, including a rise of about 59% in the hour before 07:30 UTC.
watch: Liquidity is small compared with the market cap, so large trades can move the price sharply.
The coin is about 16 hours old, and its creators have published little beyond the website and launch text.
The website's chart and follow links are still marked 'TBA' or 'Soon'.

rating.verdict: Anakin Coin is a fan-made memecoin built on Anakin Skywalker's fall from Chosen One to Darth Vader, with website chapters named after the films and series arc (The Turn, Mustafar, Join the Dark Side). The site also claims Elon Musk reposted or replied to some posts and frames the character as a symbol of right-wing extremism, a hook that could draw attention on X.
